query: List all customers who signed up after 2024-06-01
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE signup_date > '2024-06-01';

query: Count the total number of registered customers
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM customers;

query: Show all orders with status completed
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE status = 'completed';

query: Find the customer with email alice@example.com
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM customers WHERE email = 'alice@example.com';

query: List payments where amount is greater than 300
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM payments WHERE amount > 300;
SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date = '2024-03-15';
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'failed';

query: List all orders for customer id 1
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1;
SELECT * FROM payments WHERE payment_date >= '2024-11-01' AND payment_date < '2024-12-01';

query: Count how many orders have status pending
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE status = 'pending';

canonical_label: Highest Total Spend
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spend DESC;

canonical_label: Orders with payment amount over $300
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.id, o.customer_id, p.amount FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.amount > 300 AND p.payment_status = 'successful';

canonical_label: Customers with completed orders within last 90 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.name FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '90 days';

query: What is our average order value?
canonical_label: AOV for completed orders with successful payment
ground_truth_sql: SELECT AVG(p.amount) AS average_order_value FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' AND o.status = 'completed';

canonical_label: Rank customers by successful monetary payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY total_spent DESC;

canonical_label: Customers with no completed orders in over 180 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name FROM customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM orders o WHERE o.customer_id = c.id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '180 days');

query: Show the most successful customer accounts
canonical_label: Customers ranked by gross successful payment revenue
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

canonical_label: Revenue attributed to order placement date
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' AND o.order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month') AND o.order_date < DATE_TRUNC('month', CURRENT_DATE);

canonical_label: By order creation date in Q3 (July to September)
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(p.amount) AS sales FROM payments p JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' AND o.order_date >= '2024-07-01' AND o.order_date <= '2024-09-30';

query: How many purchases were made in October 2024?
canonical_label: Count of orders created in October 2024
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE order_date >= '2024-10-01' AND order_date <= '2024-10-31' AND status = 'completed';

canonical_label: Monthly revenue by payment processing date
ground_truth_sql: SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', payment_date) AS month, SUM(amount) AS revenue FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'successful' AND payment_date >= '2024-01-01' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;

canonical_label: Orders placed within the last 30 days
ground_truth_sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days' ORDER BY order_date DESC;

query: What was our sales volume in 2024?
canonical_label: Total Dollar Amount (Payments)
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_dollar_volume FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'successful' AND payment_date >= '2024-01-01' AND payment_date <= '2024-12-31';

canonical_label: Sum of successful payment charges
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_spending FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'successful';

canonical_label: Total gross revenue from successful payments
ground_truth_sql: SELECT SUM(amount) FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'successful';

canonical_label: Completed order transactions with payment status
ground_truth_sql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, o.customer_id, o.order_date, p.amount, p.payment_status FROM orders o JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id;

canonical_label: Aggregated total spend per customer
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS total_spend FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY c.id, c.name;

canonical_label: Grouped total per customer account
ground_truth_sql: SELECT c.id, c.name, SUM(p.amount) AS revenue FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.id = o.customer_id JOIN payments p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE p.payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY c.id, c.name ORDER BY revenue DESC;

canonical_label: Aggregated daily totals
ground_truth_sql: SELECT payment_date, SUM(amount) AS daily_sales FROM payments WHERE payment_status = 'successful' GROUP BY payment_date ORDER BY payment_date;

canonical_label: Overall company-wide summary aggregates
ground_truth_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_orders, COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS distinct_buyers FROM orders;
